message: Pinning a task no longer takes the rest of your day away. The task stays where it is and a copy appears in Pinned Tasks at the top, so nothing shifts as you pin: pin as many as you like in a row. "Everything else" is gone; the new eye button in the Pinned header hides the other sections when you want that, and everything shows by default. You can also drag pinned tasks into whatever order you want.
